claims.claim: Booster 22 performed a full-duration 15-second static fire with all 33 Raptor engines on October 25.
claims.episode_span: Booster 22 performed a full-duration 15-second static fire with all 33 Raptor engines on October 25 after rolling out to Pad 2 on October 24.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Completes Three Static Fires in Three Days for Flight 15
claims.supporting_quote: On Oct. 24, Booster 22 was rolled out to Pad 2 and installed on the launch mount early that morning. After completing preparations on Saturday, SpaceX ignited all 33 Raptor engines early Sunday morning, Oct. 25, for a full-duration 15-second static fire.

claims.claim: Ship 43 completed both cryo-proof tests on October 23 after rollout to Massey’s on October 22.
claims.episode_span: Ship 43 completed both cryo-proof tests on October 23 after rollout to Massey’s on October 22, then rolled back to Mega Bay 2 on October 26 to be swapped to a transport stand before moving to Pad 2 for ship catch testing.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Completes Three Static Fires in Three Days for Flight 15
claims.supporting_quote: Ship 43 rolled out to Massey’s on Oct. 22 and completed both cryo-proof tests on Oct. 23.

claims.claim: Elon Musk projected that orbital compute deployed per month will probably exceed terrestrial capacity around the end of 2028.
claims.episode_span: He projected that orbital compute deployed per month will probably exceed terrestrial capacity around the end of 2028 and then far exceed it throughout 2029.
claims.source_title: Elon Musk predicts orbital compute will surpass terrestrial by 2029
claims.supporting_quote: Orbital compute deployed per month probably exceeds terrestrial around the end of 2028 and then far exceeds it in 2029.

claims.claim: Grok Bot 1.0 reached Cursor’s production servers 77 days after entering beta.
claims.episode_span: The release integrates Grok directly into the Cursor IDE environment for developers. It does not affect other extensions downloaded from the Cursor marketplace or other SpaceXSI products.
claims.source_title: Grok Bot 1.0 Is on Cursor’s Servers, 77 Days After Beta
claims.supporting_quote: Grok Bot 1.0 Is on Cursor’s Servers, 77 Days After Beta

claims.claim: Gwynne Shotwell currently holds 2 million SpaceX shares as president.
claims.episode_span: The transfers start this December under the new account structure. Shotwell currently holds the shares as SpaceX president.
claims.source_title: SpaceX President to gift Trump Accounts her SpaceX stock
claims.supporting_quote: Gwynne Shotwell's 2 million SpaceX shares are headed to children's Trump Accounts starting this December.

claims.claim: Each AI1 satellite features 110 square meters of deployable liquid radiators rated at about 1,400 W per square meter.
claims.episode_span: This geometry keeps absorbed solar flux near zero while the ammonia-loop system, backed by redundant pumps, rejects heat at roughly 1,400 W per square meter.
claims.source_title: SpaceX details AI1 satellite 'data center,' claims 150kW peak compute
claims.supporting_quote: The assumptions here are 250W per sq m for the solar array, and about 1,400W per sqm for the radiators. The radiators are radiating both sides, orientated knife-edge to the sun.

claims.claim: The AI1 satellite supports 120 kW of average compute and 150 kW peak with a 70-meter deployed wingspan.
claims.episode_span: The design supports a sustained 120 kW compute load and 150 kW peaks without duty-cycle limits that constrained earlier small prototypes. The satellite carries the equivalent of a single Nvidia GB300 server rack containing 72 GPUs and operates at approximately 600 km altitude with a density of 70 kW per ton.
claims.source_title: Elon Musk's first-gen orbital data center craft spans wider than a Boeing 747 and runs an interchangeable chip payload
claims.supporting_quote: Carrying a 150 kW peak compute payload across a 70-meter deployed wingspan, the spacecraft uses an interchangeable hardware design that lets different chipmakers supply the processors.

claims.claim: The other Lane 1 bidders aren’t certified yet and eligible to bid.
claims.episode_span: The observation was made in the context of upcoming Lane 1 bidding where other providers remain uncertified.
claims.supporting_quote: the other Lane 1 bidders aren’t certified yet and eligible to bid
